`final class DirectThreadBridge`<br/>
**Implements:** [`IThreadBridge`](/reference/bridges/ithreadbridge/)<br/>
**Package:** `dev.joid.lib.bridge.thread` · **Module:** `core` · **Source:** [DirectThreadBridge.java](https://github.com/Zeldown/JOID/blob/main/core/src/main/java/dev/joid/lib/bridge/thread/DirectThreadBridge.java)

The thread bridge that JOID holds before any backend, for which every thread is the render thread.

## Description

It runs every task at once, on the calling thread.
A backend whose `createThreadBridge()` returns `null` keeps it.

- [Thread bridge](/build/bridges/thread/#the-default-fits-a-loop-on-the-thread-that-registers)
